headline: Asda Appoints David Potts as Group Chief Executive
summary: Supermarket chain Asda announced the appointment of David Potts as its new group chief executive.
why: Leadership changes at major retail corporations can signal shifts in corporate strategy, operational focus, and investor confidence.

impacts.name: Asda
impacts.why: A new chief executive takes direct leadership over Asda's retail operations and strategic direction.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
